Hand-corrected, not discovered as-is -- discovery's own compute_target() used the cell's own literal text as its 'name' (cell[name='Lovelace, Ada']), since MERIDIAN's tables have no <th> at all for role/name to derive a stable label from (confirmed: plain <td> grids throughout, verified via the raw HTML). That locator only ever matches the exact member discovery happened to run against. Anchored to the adjacent label cell instead, verified against a real page with a different member.
